decisionsTitle: Race results public from the start, live while the race runs, and why a line is «Participant #…»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, from the phone**, with a screenshot of «Clasament» — every line «Pe site: Participant #001», the chip «Nepublic», the alert «Cursa nu a început încă»: «pe site live trebuie sa vad lista de finish, atat ca admin cat si public, trebe sa setez ca toata lumea apare pe site, toate BIB-urile insa doar numele celor care au bifat ca vor sa apara se vad» — and «ce inseamna "Loc" aici?». Asked, he chose: (1) **public from the start** — the tick may be set now; before the start the site shows nothing, from the start every finish appears on the event page; (2) **the reason** — under every «Pe site: Participant #…» a short sentence why there is no name, and at the top «Cu nume pe site: N din M»; (3) **live** — while the race runs, the public list refreshes itself every 30 seconds while the page is open, and after the race it does nothing.

**What was there.** §808 published a race's results on the Administrator's tick alone and refused the tick before the race (`RESULTS_NOT_STARTED`), because the privacy notice's template says «Clasamentul unei curse … apare doar după cursă». The public side already waited for the event's start: the read (`readPublicEventResults`), its cached twin (`cachedPublicEventResults`), the section (§809), the listing's chip and the page's hold (`results-open.ts#resultsOnShow`, `resultsClockInstants`) showed nothing before `startsAt` and every stored row from it. Who is named is `publicResultName` (§808, §810, §879, §910). The «Pe site:» line said «Participant #bib» without saying why, and «Loc» was a column's word with nothing to explain it on a phone, where the column has no header.

**Decision 1 — the tick before the race.** `setResultsPublished(on)` no longer refuses before the start; the code `RESULTS_NOT_STARTED` is gone, since nothing throws it. FORBIDDEN, RESULTS_NOT_OPEN, RESULTS_NOTICE and RESULTS_TERMS are kept before the start as after it, taking the results off is never refused, the audit row is the same `event_results.published`, and `results_published_at` is the tick's moment. The answer says `fromStart` and the toast says the results appear on the page from the start. **Nothing that is shown changes**: before `startsAt` the read and the cached read answer nothing, the section draws nothing, the listing gives no chip and the page and the listing are held until the start, so a copy made before it is made again then — each proved with a «Neprezentat» typed two days early (`tests/integration/results/public-from-start.test.ts`). From the start every stored row shows as it is saved, and the public line «Publicat …» names the start, not the earlier tick (`domain/from-start.ts#resultsShownSince`). «Clasament» says the state from one pure rule (`resultsPublishState`): «Nepublic»; **«Public de la start»** while ticked before the race — a chip in the summary row, the card's header, and in the card the chip with «Pe site apare de la start, sâm., 21 nov. 2026, la 09:00, pe măsură ce sosesc alergătorii.»; «Public» from the start. Unticked before the race, the card says the tick may be set now; «Cursa nu a început încă» now says results may be typed and the tick set, and that nothing shows before the start; the question asked before ticking says the results show from the start. The guide's task «Publică clasamentul pe pagina evenimentului», SETUP.md §45 and the runbook say the same.

**The notice's sentence.** The privacy notice's template says «Clasamentul unei curse … apare doar după cursă», and the terms' template «îl publicăm doar după cursă». §808 already showed the results from the event's start; this keeps exactly that timing — the tick may be **set** earlier, nothing is **shown** earlier — so nothing on the page contradicts an approved text more than before. The live refresh makes it plainer that results appear while the race runs, so the club and its lawyer may want both sentences to say «de la startul cursei, pe măsură ce sosesc alergătorii». No legal template is edited: the texts are the club's (§29).

**Decision 2 — why «Participant #…».** `results/domain/public-name-reason.ts#publicNameReason`, pure, over `publicResultName`'s own input and one fact more — `hiddenByClub`: the person ticked, and an Administrator's «Apare pe site» unticked on an elite or an ambassador (§910, §948) is what reads the tick as off (`siteHiddenByClub`). It asks `publicResultName` first — `named` exactly when it gives a name — then names the first condition that failed: `noResultsNotice` (no approved notice describes the results: nobody is named; first, because every line shares it), for a runner typed by hand `noName` then `typedNoAgreement`, for a registered one `notTicked`, `hiddenByClub`, `notConfirmed`, `hiddenGuest`, `olderNotice`, `noName`. A table-driven test walks all 147 456 combinations of the input and holds the two together, and that the club's tick never moves a name. `readEventResults` hands every line `named` — still `publicResultName`'s own answer — and `nameReason` from one input (`publicNameVerdict`). «Clasament» draws the reason's sentence under each «Pe site: Participant #…» — never under a named line, an elite out of the ranking, or an erased registration's nameless line, whose own sentence says why — «Cu nume pe site: N din M» in the summary row (M, the lines the published results would show: a stored result, not an elite out of the ranking; N, those named), and, while no approved notice describes the results, that reason once at the top with a link to «Documente legale» instead of on every line. **Who is named does not change**: the function names nobody, `publicResultName` is untouched, and the public read is untouched.

**Decision 3 — live.** `results/domain/live-window.ts`: a race runs from the event's start until its end, or six hours after the start for a race saved without one (or with an end at or before its start). Only while the section is drawn and inside that window, `ResultsSection` draws `ResultsLiveRefresh` — a client island with plain props (the window's end in milliseconds and the line's words; no icon, nothing from `action-icons.ts`, no new dependency) — which calls `router.refresh()` every 30 seconds while `document.visibilityState` is `visible`, at once on becoming visible again when a refresh is due, and nothing from the window's end, when its one calm line «Se actualizează singur la 30 de secunde» goes too. Its clock is `ui/live-refresh.ts`, unit-tested with fake timers. The page is held to the window's end, so a copy made during the race is made again without the island. `ResultsFilter` narrows the rows a refresh redraws by the chip and the number already chosen. **What it costs:** one request per open, visible tab every 30 seconds during the race, answered by the static page from the CDN while nothing changed; a render and one database read only after a result is saved, because the save expires the `events` and `places` tags the section's read is filed under (§333, §549) — proved end to end on a production build with Playwright's `page.clock` (`tests/e2e/race-results-live.spec.ts`: a result saved while the visitor's page is open appears only when the page's clock reaches thirty seconds, with no reload). **Amends §577** («an open tab on a public page asks for nothing on a timer»): this is its one named exception, bounded to the race's window and to a visible tab; `tests/unit/config/idle-client.test.ts` names it and refuses any other island that refreshes a page from a timer.

**«Loc».** Above the lines of «Alergători înscriși» one sentence says it in plain words — the place in the ranking, overall and, under it, by sex and by category, worked out by the site from the times, and «fără loc încă» until a time is typed — with the ties, the category and «fără loc» behind its «?». Said above the lines rather than in the column's header, because a phone has none.

**Refused.** Publishing names on a tick given under an older notice — the older terms promised to ask first (§808, §879); the line now says so instead (`olderNotice`). A staff tick that names anybody: the club's «Apare pe site» stays a hide (§910). Showing anything before the start, or a heading «în curând». A websocket, server-sent events or a polling API: the page's own refresh through the cache is cheaper and adds no route. Refreshing a hidden tab, or after the race. Editing a legal template. A migration.

**Not done.** «Toate datele unei persoane» lists the stored flag `results_published` as it is, true from the tick though nothing shows before the start. A typed row whose number a confirmed registration took since keeps its §810 behaviour: «Clasament» reads that line as the registered runner's (and counts it so in «Cu nume pe site») while the public line is «Participant #bib» until the next «Salvează tot clasamentul» re-files it.
changelogLine: - **Race results public from the start, and live** — an Administrator can tick «Clasamentul e public pe pagina evenimentului» before the race («Public de la start», with the start's day and hour): nothing shows until the start, then every saved finish appears on the event page, which refreshes itself every 30 seconds while the race runs; «Clasament» says under each «Pe site: Participant #…» why there is no name, counts «Cu nume pe site: N din M», and explains «Loc» in plain words. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: 75. (amended) Given the privacy notice and the terms in force, when an Administrator ticks «Clasamentul e public pe pagina evenimentului», then the tick is refused with a sentence and a link to «Documente legale» unless the notice and the terms in force name `{{results}}` in both languages (the platform's templates do, replacing «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă»); before the race has started it is accepted — the answer says the results show from the start and «Clasament» says «Public de la start» — with every other refusal (FORBIDDEN, RESULTS_NOT_OPEN, RESULTS_NOTICE, RESULTS_TERMS) kept and the same audit row; taking the results off is never refused; `/admin/tasks` carries the rows `resultsNotice` and `resultsTerms` until such texts are in force. Verification: integration `results/results.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`, `results/public-from-start.test.ts`, unit `results/notice.test.ts`, `diagnostics/owner-tasks.test.ts` (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §808) (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race whose results an Administrator ticked public before it started, with a result already stored (a «Neprezentat» typed early), when the public read, its cached twin, the event page's «Clasament» and the listing are asked before the event's start, then each answers nothing — no row, no section, no heading, no chip — and the page and the listing are held until the start; from the start every stored row is shown, and the line «Publicat …» names the start, not the earlier tick. Verification: integration `results/public-from-start.test.ts`, `results/results.test.ts`; unit `results/live-refresh.test.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race's «Clasament» on its page, when the page is drawn between the event's start and its end — or six hours after the start for a race saved without an end — then the section carries one line «Se actualizează singur la 30 de secunde» and refreshes the open page every 30 seconds while the tab is visible (at once on coming back visible when a refresh is due), a result saved since appearing without a reload; outside that window there is no line and nothing is asked, and no other public island refreshes a page from a timer. Verification: unit `results/live-refresh.test.ts`, `config/idle-client.test.ts`; integration `results/public-from-start.test.ts`; e2e `race-results-live.spec.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given any input of the published results' name rule, when the reason a result carries no name is asked, then it is «named» exactly when `publicResultName` gives a name, and otherwise the first condition that failed — no approved notice describing the results, a typed runner's missing name or recorded agreement, the runner's own tick off, the club's «Apare pe site» off on a runner who ticked, a registration not confirmed, a special guest the event hides, an older notice not asked since, a blank name — and the club's tick names nobody. Verification: unit `results/public-name-reason.test.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race's «Clasament» page, when it is drawn, then under each «Pe site: Participant #…» line one sentence says why the site shows no name, in Romanian and in English, and none under a named line or an elite out of the ranking; the summary row says «Cu nume pe site: N din M» (M the lines with a result the published results would show, N those named); while no approved notice describes the results that reason is said once at the top instead of on every line; above the lines one sentence says what «Loc» is — the place overall and, under it, by sex and by category, worked out from the times, «fără loc încă» until a time is typed — with the rest behind its «?»; and, ticked before the race, the summary, the card's header and the card say «Public de la start», the card with the start's day and hour. Verification: integration `results/page-public-names.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`; e2e `race-results-live.spec.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: race results public from the start, live every 30 seconds, and why «Participant #…»
